name: RoCoBench
description: RoCoBench is a 6-task benchmark designed to evaluate multi-robot collaboration scenarios using large language models, focusing on agent representation and reasoning capabilities. It includes a text-only dataset and supports evaluation of LLM-driven communication, planning, and adaptation in multi-robot tasks.
reputation: A niche benchmark for multi-robot collaboration and reasoning that is promising for research but not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Includes text-only dataset for evaluating LLM agent reasoning; supports human-in-the-loop collaboration.
